_doc: The Huss boxing gloves, same data format as the bosses (see z1_t1.json). Cube 0.14 stud, about head size (1.3 studs tall, 1.0 wide). GloveL is authored at x = +10 cubes (0 -> its wrist), GloveR is the mirrored copy at x = -10 (a real mirror, faces wound outward, not a negative scale). The fist hangs below the wrist (Blender -z = Roblox down) and the knuckles point Blender -y (Roblox forward); the thumb is on the inner side. Pivot = the wrist, the centre of the yellow cuff's bottom face. Huss red #E02A2A (style guide section 3) with a slightly darker scatter shade; the yellow is the boss-band yellow (TEAM CALL: not Shop gold, which means Robux).
